content.title: Regional Lenders Are Merging to Answer the Challenge From Megabanks
content.summary: To become a national banking player in the U.S., it seems you must also be a local one.  PNC’s chief executive has ultimately set his sights on roughly doubling its size to $1 trillion in assets—while Colorado-based FirstBank brought in just $27 billion.

content.title: Heard on the Street Monday Recap: AMD Circles Back
content.summary: OpenAI and Advanced Micro Devices struck a multibillion-dollar partnership.  OpenAI committed to buying 6 gigawatts worth of AMD’s chips and will also receive warrants for up to 160 million AMD shares, roughly 10% of the chip company, if OpenAI hits certain deployment milestones.  The deal could add to concerns over the “circularity” of recent AI deals, which blend investments with commercial relationships.
